rules.name: Google Chrome leftovers
rules.description: Profile data, caches and preferences left behind by Google Chrome.

provenance.source: Observed install of Google Chrome on macOS 26 (2026-10-16); generic locations: https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/FileManagement/Conceptual/FileSystemProgrammingGuide/MacOSXDirectories/MacOSXDirectories.html
provenance.author: lapht
provenance.rationale: Chrome stores its profiles in Application Support/Google/Chrome and its disk cache in Caches/Google/Chrome. Only the Chrome subfolders are listed: the parent Google folders are shared with Chrome Beta, Dev, Canary and Google Updater and are never proposed. Generic per-bundle-ID locations (Caches, Preferences plist, Saved Application State, HTTPStorages, WebKit) are where macOS frameworks store data keyed by the app's bundle ID; they are matched only when they exist.

rules.name: Visual Studio Code leftovers
rules.description: Settings, caches and preferences left behind by Visual Studio Code.

provenance.source: Observed install of Visual Studio Code on macOS 26 (2026-10-16); generic locations: https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/FileManagement/Conceptual/FileSystemProgrammingGuide/MacOSXDirectories/MacOSXDirectories.html
provenance.author: lapht
provenance.rationale: VS Code stores user data in Application Support/Code (Insiders uses a separate 'Code - Insiders' folder) and its updater state in Caches/com.microsoft.VSCode.ShipIt. ~/.vscode is outside the leftover roots and is not covered. Generic per-bundle-ID locations (Caches, Preferences plist, Saved Application State, HTTPStorages, WebKit) are where macOS frameworks store data keyed by the app's bundle ID; they are matched only when they exist.

rules.name: Spotify leftovers
rules.description: Offline data, caches and preferences left behind by Spotify.

provenance.source: Observed install of Spotify on macOS 26 (2026-10-16); generic locations: https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/FileManagement/Conceptual/FileSystemProgrammingGuide/MacOSXDirectories/MacOSXDirectories.html
provenance.author: lapht
provenance.rationale: Spotify stores user data in Application Support/Spotify. The separate launcher and installer HTTPStorages entries use other bundle IDs and are not listed. Generic per-bundle-ID locations (Caches, Preferences plist, Saved Application State, HTTPStorages, WebKit) are where macOS frameworks store data keyed by the app's bundle ID; they are matched only when they exist.

rules.name: Bitwarden leftovers
rules.description: Sandbox containers and the app group container left behind by Bitwarden.

provenance.source: Observed install of Bitwarden on macOS 26 (2026-10-16); generic locations: https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/FileManagement/Conceptual/FileSystemProgrammingGuide/MacOSXDirectories/MacOSXDirectories.html; app group from the app's com.apple.security.application-groups entitlement
provenance.author: lapht
provenance.rationale: Bitwarden is sandboxed, so its data lives in its container. The loginhelper and safari containers belong to the login item and Safari extension embedded in Bitwarden.app. The group container LTZ2PFU5D6.com.bitwarden.desktop is declared in the app's application-groups entitlement and is marked shared.

rules.name: The Unarchiver leftovers
rules.description: Sandbox container left behind by The Unarchiver.

provenance.source: Observed install of The Unarchiver on macOS 26 (2026-10-16); generic locations: https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/FileManagement/Conceptual/FileSystemProgrammingGuide/MacOSXDirectories/MacOSXDirectories.html
provenance.author: lapht
provenance.rationale: The Unarchiver is sandboxed and declares no app group, so all of its data lives in its own container. Group containers of other apps from the same developer team are not listed.
